items.title: Caterpillar (CAT) Stock Looks Like A Bargain On Its 222% Run
items.summary: Caterpillar has climbed sharply over the past few years and now trades at US$601.61, which naturally raises a simple question for anyone looking at the ticker today. Is that price still anchored in what the business can earn in cash terms, or has the share move run ahead of the company’s underlying cash flows?
